title: Prevailing
summary: PREVA'ILING, participle present tense Gaining advantage, superiority or victory; having effect; persuading; succeeding. 1. adjective Predominant; having more influence; prevalent; superior in power. T

inlines.v: PREVA'ILING, participle present tense Gaining advantage, superiority or victory; having effect; persuading; succeeding. 1. adjective Predominant; having more influence; prevalent; superior in power. The love of money and the love of power are the prevailing passions of men. 2. Efficacious. Saints shall assist thee with prevailing prayers. 3. Predominant; most general; as the prevailing disease of a climate; a prevailing opinion. Intemperance is the prevailing vice of many countries.
